## Checklist

- [ ] One concern, small diff
- [ ] `bun run check`, `bun run lint`, `bun run test` and `bun run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behaviour
- [ ] No secrets in code, listings, fixtures, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Docs updated, and `docs/DECISIONS.md` appended if a decision changed
- [ ] UI change: checked in light and dark themes, keyboard and focus order, and contrast (say what you checked below)
- [ ] User-facing text does not call code widgets sandboxed, secure or safe
- [ ] Registry or `.github/` change: maintainer review requested (CODEOWNERS)
